description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build autonomous agents designed to handle complex computer-based work over extended periods. You will own core agent systems, from long-running execution and memory to evaluations that measure performance against human baselines.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agents that pursue goals over multiple weeks with minimal human intervention.

 - Design memory systems that help agents retain knowledge and improve as they work.

 - Develop evaluation frameworks to determine whether agents outperform people on specific tasks.

 - Improve reliability and reduce the need for human review of agent runs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building production agents that people rely on, including a clear understanding of their failure modes.

 - Experience building memory-enabled agents, long-running execution systems, or multi-step reasoning systems that maintain goal coherence.

 - A track record of creating evaluations that inform real decisions and measure performance against human-level baselines.

 - At least 1 to 2 years at a fast-growing or AI-focused startup.

 - Substantive engineering experience, plus either published research that others build on or software shipped at meaningful scale.

 - Strong agent architecture perspectives are a plus. Experience at an AI data lab, competitive math, programming, debate, games, or founding a company may also be relevant.

 - Collaborative, kind, and effective in challenging situations.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$200,000 to $300,000 base salary, with up to $350,000 for exceptional candidates, plus meaningful founding equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site five days a week in San Francisco, California, United States.
